page.notes: The top running head and the top-left folio mark are too faint to read and are left out. Page number read as 314 but uncertain. Several Hebrew roots and Latin glosses are damaged or overprinted (marked [?]): "divisa" root, "separabimur", "judicatus est", and the root letters of several entries. The Hebrew forms in the left column are only partly legible; the Latin text reads more clearly than the Hebrew vowel points, which are not reproduced.
